description: This file defines the WorkflowPermissionsBuilder class and related utility functions for managing workflow permissions, including caching and batch processing, within a TypeScript project.

classes.name: WorkflowPermissionsBuilder
classes.description: A class for building and caching permissions for workflows based on user and team context.

methods.name: getTeamPermissions
methods.description: Fetches and caches permissions for a specific team.

methods.name: getPersonalWorkflowPermissions
methods.description: Determines permissions for personal workflows based on ownership.

methods.name: buildPermissions
methods.description: Builds permissions for a single workflow, handling personal and team workflows.

methods.name: buildPermissionsForWorkflows
methods.description: Batch builds permissions for multiple workflows, optimizing team permission fetches.

methods.name: buildPermissions (static)
methods.description: Static factory method to build permissions for a workflow.

methods.name: buildPermissionsForWorkflows (static)
methods.description: Static method to batch build permissions for multiple workflows.
